criteria.title: Reconstruct a forced event schedule, happens-before obligations and a wait-for graph while separating mutex correctness from timing observations.
criteria.task: Build wait-for and happens-before graphs for forced two-thread schedules; include a lock-order cycle and an unordered non-atomic conflict. State edge provenance rather than deriving ordering from timestamps.
criteria.purpose: Temporal order in a log is synchronization or every cycle is a demonstrated current deadlock.
